run_f_gold: run f_gold to count possible paths from top-left to bottom-right in a p by q matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a 1D DP array to compute grid path counts
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming approach that iterates rows and accumulates path counts
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept a single tuple argument instead of two separate parameters
